February 17

10 For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister. (Hebrews 6:10 KJV)

Most Christians think that God only remembers the bad things we do, but He does not even impute our sins to us anymore (Hebrews 8:12), but He does remember the good things we do and keeps track of them. What a wonderful thought, that our Lord only sees the good in us, and what we do, and does not look upon the bad that we do. That is hard for us carnal humans to understand, as we seem to think on all the bad things in this life, and not the good like the word says (Philippians 4:8). What a wonderful God and Father we have, and as His children we should be thanking Him every day, in every way.

It makes serving God all the more rewarding, just to know that He sees what we do for Him and His kingdom. Jesus said that what we do to His little ones is as if we are doing it unto Him (Matthew 25:40), so this is saying the same thing. We should do everything in our lives, from serving Him, to just working in this world, as if we were doing it for Jesus, as in God’s sight we are doing just that (Ephesians 6:6-7). If we would think that way, we would be much better at all we do, than if we just think we are working for our bosses. Everything we do, we should do as unto the Lord, and that includes what we say and think. Praise God for His mercy, as well as His directions.
